parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment quotes "2 also leads to the following Corollary" and mentions "Table 1." However, the reference to "2" does not identify which section, theorem, or result this number corresponds to, so the authors cannot confidently determine which part the first criticism addresses. The mention of "Table 1" gives some grounding, but without further context about what in the table is inadequate, the references remain ambiguous. Thus the comment is not fully grounded; the authors can at best make an educated guess about the referenced parts. On the other hand, the comment does specify what needs to be addressed: the implication of the result is unclear, the differences between LR-EDLAE-1 and LR-EDLAE-2 are not carefully detailed, and Table 1 would be clearer if it identified the best methods. These are concrete issues the authors could act upon once the referenced parts are identified. Therefore, the comment specifies the problems clearly but does not allow the authors to confidently pinpoint the referenced parts.
